text: When a downstream consumer is a positive spectral-moment map, first bind post-quotient density and a common exponential rate. Do not automatically import a generic pointwise-to-uniformity warning as a requirement for source-uniform prefactors: the spectral projection argument may make finite source-dependent prefactors sufficient.
scope: positive self-adjoint transfer moments on a dense reconstructed excited source image with common rate; not arbitrary observables, moving cutoffs, or continuum limits
cheapest_prospective_discriminator: paired target fixtures: (A) dense source image + common q0 + unbounded C_v across sources, which should still exclude spectrum above q0; (B) dense source image + source-dependent q_v -> 1, which should not

framework_improvement_hypothesis.hypothesis: benchmark an optional consumer-map field recording kernel/image-density and whether uniformity is needed in rate, prefactor, or both
framework_improvement_hypothesis.expected_benefit: reduce false transfer of generic uniformity warnings into positive-moment spectral settings and surface the exact target coordinate earlier
framework_improvement_hypothesis.possible_regression: over-linearize nonlinear consumers or add schema burden where no spectral structure exists
framework_improvement_hypothesis.issue_status: NO_RAKL_ISSUE_OPENED: current v3 already supports QoI/consumer/DifferenceWitness typing; evidence supports a benchmark hypothesis, not a missing mandatory framework feature
